name: Ikebana Dones and the Great Adventure
storyline: Somewhere beneath the desert lies an ancient temple of sealed chambers — and someone has left flowerpots in every single one. Ikebana Dones sets out to gather them all. Each chamber opens its door only once every pot has been collected, but the temple’s tenants have other plans: mummies block the way, spiders watch in all four directions, snakes awaken the moment the last pot is taken, and skeletons and ghosts give chase. Armed with nothing but a freezing shot and a lot of patience, Ikebana must push crates, ride frozen creatures across underground currents and think several moves ahead to make it through the temple and reach the end of the great adventure.
summary:
A grid-based puzzle adventure through ancient chambers for Playdate. Collect every pot in the room, then reach the door, simple, until you meet the tenants. Mummies sit in the way, spiders watch four directions at once, snakes wake up the moment the last pot is taken, and skeletons and ghosts come after you.

Your only tool is a shot: the first hit freezes a creature in place, the second finishes it off. Knowing when not to fire twice is the real puzzle: a frozen creature can be pushed like a crate, floated down a current as a raft, or parked in exactly the square that saves your life.

Made a mistake? Turn the crank to rewind time move by move, even past your own death. No reflexes, no luck – just a room, a plan, and the growing suspicion that you pushed that crate one square too far.
